generation.description: Ordered within one authenticated native host, across every thread.

incarnation.description: Opaque native runtime incarnation. Its bytes are never compared for order.

persistence.description: Absent on retirement; an older peer or unavailable runtime remains unknown.

reset.description: Passive stream overflow invalidates observations, never goal/accounting state.

sequence.description: Assigned by the native server sink, ordered within that backend transport.

transport.description: Exact native server-sink lifetime; reconnects to a new server cannot reuse its sequence.
